run_arc_fake_data: run the arc.py module to generate fake ARC-like training and evaluation task JSON files
test_make_grid_data: test the make_grid_data function to generate random 2D grid data with integer values
test_make_pair: test the make_pair function to create an input-output pair of random grid data
test_make_task: test the make_task function to build a task with random training and test pairs
test_write_task: test the write_task function to write a task dictionary as a JSON file to a specified output directory
